'''Docking Bay 65''' was located in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Advozse/Legends|Advozsec]] [[Bom Vimdin/Legends|Bom Vimdin]] docked his [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], ''[[Blood Freeze]]'', in Docking Bay 65.<ref name="Betwixt" />
